source.locator: pp77-79 internal LNA/coexistence; pp93-94 passive typical design

receiver_configuration.verification: Read actual RAM/BBR configuration and applicable firmware interface description; setting takes effect after reset. Do not infer actual configuration from default or program OTP for experiments.

options.purpose: Characterize passive antenna, integrated matching/DC block/Band13 notch/LNA/SAW, and selected connector ESD adaptation before choosing additional filtering.
options.initial_restriction: Disable co-located transmitters during initial GNSS bring-up. Concurrent radio operation requires a controlled coexistence experiment, not presumed service availability.

prerequisites: Measured or justified worst-case antenna coupling over enabled transmit bands
Complete occupied GNSS passband and sensitivity/loss review
Source/load S-parameter models and case-specific series-C/shunt-L/series-C ESD network
Exact component footprints, process and availability review
options.approval: Requires new source and routed package; not a solder-population option on an unmodified baseline PCB. No fabricated filter values or branch stubs are prescribed.

post_delivery_evidence: Actual receiver gain/firmware and active constellation configuration
Antenna-to-antenna S21 over every enabled LTE transmit band
Cold-start/tracking C/N0 and navigation availability versus transmitter-off baseline
Maximum-power LTE and BLE, charging and battery USB operating states
Full-path insertion loss/match and system ESD validation
